biotools.summary: GoFCards is a database and analytic platform for gain-of-function variants in humans, integrating data from literature reviews and predicted variants with a proprietary scoring system. It aims to provide geneticists and clinicians with a convenient resource for understanding and prioritizing genetic variants associated with diseases.
